original.subject: Sample 24-1187 – Effluent Line – pH 9.3, Caustic 38 mg/L
original.body:
Sample ID: 24-1187
Source: Effluent line, RWTP
Collection Time: 09:18
pH: 9.3
Caustic dose (measured): 38 mg/L

Alert: pH > 9.5, Caustic > 40 mg/L (PLC clamp) — trigger for advisory

System note: This exceeds the PLC hard limit (40 mg/L) and confirms a control-system anomaly.

LIMS report with full traceability attached.

instructorNote: This inject confirms the lab evidence for overfeed and triggers the advisory decision clock. Watch for WQ to declare a Level 3 condition and for IC to initiate escalation.
